AboutPage.title: ABOUT | OU9999
AboutPage.paragraph1: My mother is the kind of person who improves even the smallest inconvenient things. That has always stayed with me. Even in a different field, I feel I share a similar instinct.
AboutPage.paragraph2: My parents watched me more than they judged me. Growing up with that kind of attention made it feel natural to love the world as it is.
